For meeting information, contact the City Clerk, (512) 974-2210
The City Council will convene at 1:00 PM on 
Thursday, February 14, 2019 at the Austin 
Central Library, Special Events Center, 1st 
Floor, 710 W Cesar Chavez St, Austin, TX 
78701
Special Called Meeting
Council Discussion
Discuss policy priorities, goals, and the potential impacts on governance for the City of Austin.
1.
 Adjourn
The City of Austin is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act.
Reasonable modifications and equal access to communications will be provided upon request.
For assistance, please call 512-974-2210 or TTY users route through 711.
A person may request a Spanish language interpreter be made available by contacting the Office of the City Clerk not later 
than twenty-four hours before the scheduled time of the item on which the person wishes to speak.  Please call (512) 974-2210 
in advance or inform the City Clerk’s staff present at the council meeting.
Cualquier persona puede solicitar servicios de intérprete en español comunicándose con la oficina del Secretario/a Municipal 
a no más tardar de veinte y cuatro  horas antes de la hora determinada para el asunto sobre el cual la persona desea comentar. 
Por favor llame al (512) 974-2210 con anticipo o informe al personal del Secretario/a Municipal presente en la sesión del 
Consejo.
